senses.definition: The eighteenth letter of the Classical and Modern Greek alphabets (Σ, σ), the twentieth letter of Old and Ancient.

quotes.text: Their names, which are expressive of some bodily or mental excellence, all end with the same letter---the letter which is called San by the Dorians, and Sigma by the Ionians.
quotes.reference: "Herodotus: On The Customs of the Persians", I.139

senses.definition: (mathematics) The symbol Σ, used to indicate summation of a set or series.
(statistics) The symbol σ, used to indicate one standard deviation from the mean, particularly in a normal distribution.
examples:
2011, Paul Rincon, (bbc.co.uk) LHC: Higgs boson 'may have been glimpsed'
None of the spikes seen by the experiments is at much more than the "two sigma" level of certainty.
A level of "five sigma" is required to claim a discovery, meaning there is less than a one in a million chance the data spike is down to a statistical fluke.

senses.definition: (Internet slang) A sigma male (a self-reliant and assertive male).
(Internet slang) Possessing characteristics of a sigma male.
